readThisFirst: A SUBMITTER-SUPPLIED family map, of the shape --family-map takes. It exists so the Semgrep-shaped intake can be exercised end to end without the benchmark itself shipping a mapping for a rule nobody has confirmed. The scorer records this file's path and sha256 in the result, which is what keeps a score computed under a private mapping distinguishable from one computed under the benchmark's own.

families.claim: Same claim as the benchmark's own family of this name.

rules.provenance: A user-written Semgrep rule, named in the shape-derived fixture beside this file. It is NOT a rule from any published pack.
